Information from spouse was also obtained. Questions were asked in 1972 (age 26 years),  1982 (age 36 years), 1989 (age 43 years), 1999 (age 53 years), 2006-10 (age 60-64 years), 2015 (age 69 years), 2023 (age 77 years) and 2025 (age 79 years).
